description: This file defines the IdentityStoreClient class which interacts with the AWS SSO Identity Store service. It contains method annotations for various operations such as creating, deleting, describing, and listing groups and users, as well as managing group memberships within AWS.

classes.name: IdentityStoreClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the AWS SSO Identity Store service. Extends AwsClient and provides method annotations for various identity management operations.

methods.name: createGroup
methods.description: Creates a new group in the AWS SSO Identity Store.

methods.name: createGroupAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new group in the AWS SSO Identity Store.

methods.name: createGroupMembershipAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new group membership.

methods.name: describeGroup
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific group.

methods.name: describeGroupAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details about a specific group.

methods.name: describeUser
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific user.

methods.name: describeUserAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details about a user.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a group.

methods.name: getGroupIdAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the ID of a group.

methods.name: getGroupMembershipId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a group membership.

methods.name: getGroupMembershipIdAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the ID of a group membership.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a user.

methods.name: getUserIdAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the ID of a user.

methods.name: isMemberInGroups
methods.description: Checks if a member belongs to specified groups.

methods.name: isMemberInGroupsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously checks group membership of a member.

methods.name: listGroupMembershipsForMember
methods.description: Lists group memberships for a specific member.

methods.name: listGroupMembershipsForMemberAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists group memberships for a member.
